steps.command: set -e; ip link add t1 type vrf table 101; ip link add t2 type vrf table 102; ip link set t1 up; ip link set t2 up; ip link set p1-eth0 master t1; ip link set p1-eth1 master t1; ip link set p1-eth2 master t2; ip link set p1-eth3 master t2; ip link set p1-eth0 up; ip link set p1-eth1 up; ip link set p1-eth2 up; ip link set p1-eth3 up; ip addr add 10.20.1.1/24 dev p1-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.12.1/30 dev p1-eth1; ip addr add 10.20.1.1/24 dev p1-eth2; ip addr add 10.20.12.1/30 dev p1-eth3; sysctl -qw net.ipv4.ip_forward=1; ip route add 10.20.2.0/24 via 10.20.12.2 dev p1-eth1 table 101; ip route add 10.20.2.0/24 via 10.20.12.2 dev p1-eth3 table 102

set -e; ip link add t1 type vrf table 101; ip link add t2 type vrf table 102; ip link set t1 up; ip link set t2 up; ip link set p2-eth0 master t1; ip link set p2-eth1 master t1; ip link set p2-eth2 master t2; ip link set p2-eth3 master t2; ip link set p2-eth0 up; ip link set p2-eth1 up; ip link set p2-eth2 up; ip link set p2-eth3 up; ip addr add 10.20.2.1/24 dev p2-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.12.2/30 dev p2-eth1; ip addr add 10.20.2.1/24 dev p2-eth2; ip addr add 10.20.12.2/30 dev p2-eth3; sysctl -qw net.ipv4.ip_forward=1; ip route add 10.20.1.0/24 via 10.20.12.1 dev p2-eth1 table 101; ip route add 10.20.1.0/24 via 10.20.12.1 dev p2-eth3 table 102
ip addr flush dev a1-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.1.2/24 dev a1-eth0; ip link set a1-eth0 up; ip route add default via 10.20.1.1
ip addr flush dev a2-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.2.2/24 dev a2-eth0; ip link set a2-eth0 up; ip route add default via 10.20.2.1
ip addr flush dev b1-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.1.3/24 dev b1-eth0; ip link set b1-eth0 up; ip route add default via 10.20.1.1
ip addr flush dev b2-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.2.3/24 dev b2-eth0; ip link set b2-eth0 up; ip route add default via 10.20.2.1
ping -c 1 -W 2 10.20.1.3; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then echo "tenant A leaked to B (exit $rc)" >&2; exit 1; fi
ping -c 1 -W 2 10.20.2.3; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then echo "tenant A leaked to B service (exit $rc)" >&2; exit 1; fi
ping -c 1 -W 2 10.20.1.2; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then echo "tenant B leaked to A (exit $rc)" >&2; exit 1; fi
ip route show table 101 | grep '10.20.2.0/24' && ip route show table 102 | grep '10.20.2.0/24'
